'''Rod Latham Skrilling Drainer''' is a [[Dark]] deck by [[Rod Latham]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/bb8.htm Skrilling Drainer], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20031207132858/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/bb8.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

* '''Player:''' [[Rod Latham]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Special Edition]] (from the card pool)

* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
